blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—For the second straight game, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson delivered a performance that put TNT on the cusp of sweeping the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series with Magnolia. That despite facing a team known for its defensive tenacity. “I think they have a wonderful defensive team with their physicality, their size,” Hollis-Jefferson said after dropping 39 points while being guarded by Zavier Lucero and Rome dela Rosa throughout Wednesday’s Game 2 at Ynares Center here. Hollis-Jefferson started the series with 26 points, nine rebounds, five assists and three steals in Game 1 as TNT walloped Magnolia, 92-70, to begin the best-of-five series. […]...
